subjectMappings.subject: router on/off
subjectMappings.mapping: a full-width hero band: a large Instrument Serif sentence ("Routing to workers.") beside a machined toggle glowing teal when on; the ground glow shifts teal to clay over 600ms when the router flips

subjectMappings.subject: four ordered tiers
subjectMappings.mapping: each tier owns a hue region (teal, green, amber, clay) that appears as a glowing dot, a sparkline stroke and a segment of the spend bar; tier cards in the stat wall carry their hue as a 1px top highlight and a soft underglow

subjectMappings.subject: spend and calls
subjectMappings.mapping: the stat wall's figures count up from zero on first paint over 700ms with tabular Geist Mono digits, each with a 7-day sparkline that draws in left to right; the spend bar fills with a staggered sweep

subjectMappings.subject: the whole product
subjectMappings.mapping: panels are machined: a graphite surface one step lighter than the ground, a 1px inner top highlight at white 8%, a 1px ink-black outer edge and a tinted drop shadow, so the UI reads as an instrument, not a printed sheet

ground.source: graphite oklch(0.17 0.01 260) with two layered radial gradients: a wide state glow top-center at 14% opacity in the router hue, and a faint cool vignette at the bottom corners; a 1px noise overlay at 3% keeps it from banding
ground.textSeparation: primary text oklch(0.96 0.005 260) on ground at least 14:1; muted text oklch(0.72 0.01 260) at least 6:1; the glow never exceeds 16% opacity behind text
ground.reducedMotion: the glow color swaps instantly on router change; nothing drifts

quietRegions.region: gap between the stat wall and the tables

palette.regionalAssignment: graphite neutrals own ground, panels and text; each tier hue owns only its dot, sparkline, bar segment and card highlight; teal is the router-on glow and focus ring, clay the router-off glow

traits.construction: high-contrast transitional serif display over a geometric grotesk body
traits.utility: Geist Mono for ids and money
traits.display: Instrument Serif 400 at 44-64px for the hero sentence and page titles, never for labels

display.sourceEvidence: user on v2: "fonts look bad"; family offered in the v3 sketch tab for the user to pick

body.sourceEvidence: user on v2: "fonts look bad"; family offered in the v3 sketch tab for the user to pick

contract.materialLight: one light from above: panels carry a 1px inner top highlight and a soft shadow tinted by the graphite hue; controls are inset wells with a darker top edge; hovered cards lift 2px and their highlight brightens

motion.decision: figures count up over 700ms ease-out-expo; sparklines draw in over 900ms, 60ms stagger; cards rise 8px, 40ms stagger; router flip shifts the glow over 600ms with a spring knob; nav indicator slides 220ms; save bar springs up
motion.reducedMotion: figures and sparklines render at final state; no rise, slide or glow shift; hover color changes only

expectations: the Overview opens on a full-width hero band with an Instrument Serif sentence stating where tasks go and a glowing toggle
a stat wall of four tier cards shows counted-up spend and calls with a sparkline each, in the tier's hue
the ground shows a visible radial glow in the router's hue, not a flat fill
panels have an inner top highlight and a tinted shadow; no flat bordered boxes
numbers use Geist Mono with tabular figures
prefers-reduced-motion removes every count, draw, rise and glow shift
contract.title: Night instrument
contract.description: A dark graphite instrument panel: a big serif sentence says where tasks go, the ground glows in the router's color, and tier cards count up their spend with sparklines that draw in.
